summary.text: Jacob Parkman, a Republican write-in candidate and educator, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Arizona's 3rd Congressional District to Yassamin Ansari.
He holds a Ph.D. in chemistry and has taught at the high-school, community-college and university levels.

paragraphs.text: Parkman earned a high school diploma from Boynton High School, a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University-Idaho in 2015 and a Ph.D. from Brigham Young University in 2023.
He has worked as an adjunct professor. In his Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a husband, father of six, educator and scientist.
Parkman describes his faith in Jesus Christ as the foundation of his values and ran as a Republican write-in in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He ran as a Republican write-in candidate for Arizona's 3rd Congressional District after no Republican met the vote threshold to advance from the primary.
Jacob Parkman lost to Yassamin Ansari, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
